tokentrim pro purchase

You can buy the Pro version of tokentrim here. After payment, the Pro features unlock automatically in your local installation.

How to add Pro to your existing tokentrim install

  1. Open this page.
  2. Pick the lifetime option ($49) or the monthly plan ($9 / month).
  3. Pay through Polar.
  4. The Pro features are enabled in your local setup right away.

What you get with Pro

  • Hosted dashboard that opens on any device.
  • Monday digest and weekly budget alert at 80 % of your daily limit.
  • Slack totals to view token usage across sessions.
  • Use Pro on up to 3 machines.
  • All free features stay: Claude Code hooks, three strength profiles, replay command, local dashboard, daily‑budget guard, cold‑cache alert.

The Pro license costs $49 for the first 500 buyers or $9 / month.

FAQ

Does Pro send any data off my computer? No. Nothing leaves your machine by default. The hosted dashboard only shows data you choose to sync.

Can I try Pro before buying? There is no trial. The free version already includes the core hooks, replay command and local dashboard, so you can see the savings (up to 75 % history re‑read reduction, 4.0× longer limits) before deciding.

What Python version do I need? Python 3.9 or newer. The tool is tested on macOS and Linux.

Proceed to purchase Pro
